name: Houston Hyperscale — 4202 Fidelity adaptive reuse campus
priceBasis: Request for offer; no asking price published
apnStatus: Not verified; exact offered legal description and title remain outstanding
availability: Direct Marcus & Millichap listing offers the property for sale with request-for-offer pricing as reviewed2026-10-29. Seller confirmation and control terms not obtained.
whyMatch: Serverfarm's September2026 financing supports existing Houston campus expansion and Atlanta building conversion; this offered Houston industrial campus presents the same combination of existing structures, existing electrical infrastructure and potential modernization. This is an actual reuse opportunity in a documented active market, rather than matching solely on land area. It still must beat Serverfarm's existing pipeline on cost, customer access and time to delivery.
specificRequirementsMatched: Existing buildings and electrical infrastructure for reuse analysis
Potential phased development rather than small isolated bare land
blockingQuestions: Main broker page lists497,289SF, whereas an earlier broker email markets approximately700,000SF; reconcile surveyed improvements and included buildings.

Main page markets40MW2026 and79MW within24months; older broker material says74MW. Obtain current utility engineering, executed rights, cost, timing and assignability. No available capacity is independently verified.

Public listing claims heavy-industrial zoning and onsite generation permission. Houston generally has no conventional zoning: verify exact jurisdiction, deed restrictions, land-use and air approvals instead of treating this wording as an official entitlement.
1961 industrial structures require PhaseI/targeted environmental, structural, floorloading, fire/life-safety and redevelopment-cost diligence.
Seven nearby fiber providers do not prove diverse physical routes or on-net service.
Confirm flood/storm-surge/drainage risks, insurance costs and current Texas data-center permitting dependencies.
Request asking economics, vacancy/delivery obligations and a buyer-backed control structure; affordable founder option terms are unverified.
powerStatus: Broker advertises existing property-owned substation and two138kVfeeds;40MW/79MW claims not utility-verified
status: CALL SPRINT / adaptive-reuse diligence and buyer requirement
probabilityStatus: Power-only conditional scenario remains subject to reuse economics, environmental risk, customer demand and financing; no calibrated forecast

name: Jackson South Corporate Park — offered Hillsboro campus land
priceBasis: Contact broker; outright campus land sale is expressly available
availability: Direct broker page explicitly offers lease/sale, campus land sale and modifiable BTS site plan as reviewed2026-10-29; current encumbrances and competing commitments not checked
whyMatch: Crane's documented Forest Grove campus relies on the Hillsboro data-center ecosystem, multiple network paths and low-TCO renewable service. This32.07-acre offered campus is in Hillsboro itself, with an explicit ability to replace the speculative manufacturing plan with a campus/BTS or outright land sale. It offers a much more meaningful site-planning test than the7.15-acre Kingwood exception. No claim that32ac can support100+MW is made; that requires a capacity-specific layout and electrical study.
specificRequirementsMatched: Hillsboro network/customer ecosystem targeted by Crane's Portland project
Seller expressly offers campus land transaction and adaptable design
Potential purpose-built redevelopment before speculative manufacturing construction
blockingQuestions: Confirm that land remains available before the advertised2027 construction start and that no industrial tenants have binding commitments.
Broker syndication calls zoning Industrial Sanctuary; obtain official permitted-use determination for a data center and relevant restrictions rather than assuming general industrial eligibility.
Prepare net usable site layout for Crane's requested first phase and ultimate capacity, including substation, generators, cooling and buffers.
Establish independent fiber routes, customer latency and utility delivery terms; nearby data-center users do not reserve power for this site.
Determine whether Crane seeks another Portland campus and whether proposed capacity creates advantage over its existing expansion.
Reconcile three/four-building and construction-date differences across listing versions; obtain the current site plan.
Ask land price, extension terms and whether the seller will accept buyer-backed conditional control; low-capital affordability is unestablished.
powerStatus: No capacity marketed in direct listing; power suitability remains solely the requested scenario assumption
status: CALL SPRINT / buyer program and campus layout qualification
probabilityStatus: No empirical conversion data; only a hypothetical construction-start scenario after power proof

name: 339th Avenue &Van Buren — power-campus site screen
address: Northeast corner339th Avenue and Van Buren Street, Tonopah / unincorporated Maricopa County, AZ
priceBasis: Submit offer; divisible per direct broker listing
apnStatus: Exact identifiers published by broker; county boundaries/title not yet reconciled
availability: Direct Land Advisors listing advertises275.16divisible acres for sale as reviewed2026-10-29; seller availability/control terms not confirmed
whyMatch: Takanock explicitly targets constrained Phoenix markets with generation-supported data-center campuses. This is a large offered industrial tract in the West Phoenix corridor with broker-identified Southwest Gas and APS service counterparts and advertised utility-extension agreements. Those characteristics justify testing generation, fuel and grid integration together, beyond merely finding land near a transmission line. It is a potential power-campus development position, not proof Takanock would operate a data center or purchase an option.
specificRequirementsMatched: Disclosed Takanock West Phoenix market strategy
Large industrial site to investigate generation plus DC layout
Named gas/electric counterparties and advertised extension agreements
blockingQuestions: Critical flood issue: broker says an approved CLOMR WILL remove property from floodplain. Verify completed channel/fill works, cost, permits and final map status; do not label currently outside floodplain.
Gas service is not firm generation-scale transport. Obtain pressure, volume, pipeline lateral, transport contract, reliability and expansion feasibility.
Industrial zoning does not prove DC or power-plant permission. Examine actual county decision, setbacks, air approvals, noise, military/aviation compatibility and environmental-review requirements.
Confirm APS service/interconnection agreement scope, assignment, export/import limits, deposits and capacity/timing; none is verified here.
Establish fiber diversity and whether customer network requirements tolerate this location45miles west of Phoenix.
Takanock may prefer selling power on another party's land rather than buying control. Qualify desired transaction and anchor customer before negotiating.
Obtain price, title/APNs, net usable acres after drainage infrastructure, and seller willingness to accept a funded buyer-backed structure.
powerStatus: Broker identifies APS and utility-extension agreements; no available MW verified. Generation fuel availability is separately unknown.
status: HOLD / flood-remediation and generation feasibility first
probabilityStatus: No genuine forecast before flood, fuel and buyer model are established; power-only assumption does not remove these vetoes
